'''Fear moss''' was a type of solitary predatory [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which would hang above [[Water/Legends|water]] holes and cover [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that came near, so as to live off their bodily fluids. It enjoyed the adrenaline and other chemicals that frightened animals produced, so it secreted a type of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to ensure that it could consume these. When a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] creature was affected by this poison, it would lose control of its fear and drift closer to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Such dark side creatures were particularly appealing to the moss, as it could taste the increased fear that they had. Fear mosses were Force-sensitive, being able to sense those who came near; they could detect Force-sensitive beings from dozens of meters away. Force-sensitive beings felt [[Mind trick/Legends|unnatural fear]] when close to fear moss, even without being poisoned.
